acceptance.dialogue: Exact words once in every tested case and seed, independently checked with Qwen and SenseVoice/VAD; disagreements require review
acceptance.speed: At least 1.5x paired median end-to-end speed versus base
acceptance.timing: Report +/-0.25s boundary and containment separately; no claim of hard timeline compliance if either fails
acceptance.visual: Review sampled frames for identity, physical continuity, planned action and static-camera constraints; full playback and lip-sync remain separate acceptance
acceptance.default: Do not promote if confirmed dialogue/visual failures occur or necessary acceptance remains unresolved

limits: Three seeds are a stress test, not a population failure-rate estimate
Only two short single-speaker Ref2VA scenes; no claim for multi-speaker, long clips or storyboard references
314159 runs predate the live-service upgrade; isolated runtime and weights are unchanged, but idle GPU use differs by about 282MiB
